🔮 Add-ons

  • Browse official and community-reviewed extensions on the Blender Extensions Platform (Blender 4.2+), or check the built-in add-ons documentation.

🌊 Simulation/Physics

  • FLIP Fluids : Powerful liquid simulation plugin that gives you the ability to create high quality fluid effects all within Blender, the free and open source 3D creation suite.
  • MolecularNodes : Import, animate, and simulate molecular biology and structural data inside Blender using Geometry Nodes.
  • Molecular+ : Modernized continuation of the Molecular Script add-on for particle collisions, linking, and physics simulations in Blender 4.x.
  • Jet-Fluids : Jet fluid simulator integration in blender.
  • projectile : An artist-friendly tool for throwing stuff around inside blender.
  • Phobos : An add-on for Blender allowing to create URDF, SDF and SMURF robot models.
  • Blender Optics Simulator : An add-on that turns Blender into a physics-checked optical bench: live beam tracing with polarization and Gaussian-beam propagation, real opto-mechanical mounts, and a headless Python API.
  • Stop-motion-OBJ : Import sequences of .obj, .ply, or .stl mesh files (such as external fluid or particle simulations) as animated mesh sequences in Blender.

🦑 Generator/Builder

  • CharMorph : Open-source character creation tool for Blender, built as a modern rewrite of MB-Lab.
  • MPFB : Open-source human generator for Blender and complete rewrite of MakeHuman as a native add-on.
  • FaceBuilder [$] : Creates photorealistic 3D models of human faces and heads from a few reference photographs. [medium]
  • Auto-Terrainer : Turns any low-poly mesh into realistic, customizable terrain such as mountains, valleys, islands, and deserts.
  • Blender Data Visualisation : Loads data into Blender and generates 3D charts and visualizations.
  • BookGen : Free book-generation add-on for shelves and interior scenes in Blender.
  • Buildify : Geometry Nodes library for modular procedural building creation.
  • Bricker [$] : Converts 3D meshes and simulations into photorealistic Lego and Minecraft brick models.
  • Celtic Knot : Generates Bezier curves, pipes, and ribbons in elaborate weavings from a framework mesh.
  • Data-FX : Loads and visualizes data within Blender from .csv files.
  • Mesh Maze : Generates procedural maze patterns over any mesh surface.
  • Modular Tree : Node-based procedural tree and vegetation generator for Blender.
  • Sapling Tree Gen : Parametric Weber-Penn trees with leaves, pruning, armature rigs, and wind animation.
  • Snow Generator : Procedural snow accumulation generator for 3D surfaces.
  • Spaceship Generator : Procedurally generates 3D spaceships in Blender.
  • Sprytile : Builds tile-based low-poly scenes in Blender with paint and map-editor tools. [more info]
  • tree-gen : Procedural tree model generator in Blender.
  • Welder : Generates realistic weld seams along object intersections.
  • Environment:
    • Infinigen : Procedural generator of photorealistic 3D worlds, nature, and indoor scenes using real geometry, optimized for computer vision and 3D training data.
    • Graswald Assets : High-quality photorealistic vegetation, weed, and nature asset library, freely available for the Blender community.
    • SceneCity [$] : Generates large-scale road networks and places tens of thousands of procedural and custom buildings.
    • The Grove 3D [$] : Simulates natural tree growth, branching, pruning, and seasonal changes for visualization and film.
  • Scatter:
    • Geo-Scatter [$] : Professional biome and instancing scattering system for Blender.
    • BagaPie Modifier : Modifier and Geometry Nodes preset toolkit including booleans, scattering, arrays, and architecture tools.
    • City Scatter : Generates cityscape concepts powered by Blender's collection system.
  • Geometry Nodes Packs & Presets:
    • Geometry Nodes Demo : Official Blender Geometry Nodes example files, including procedural buildings and hex grids.
    • Higgsas Geometry Nodes : Extensive collection of utility and deformer node groups for Geometry Nodes, plus Mesh Tension Map.
    • b3dsdf : Over 170 signed distance functions (SDF), vector operations, and procedural utility node groups for Shader Editor and Geometry Nodes in Blender.
    • Curtis Holt's Generators : Free Geometry Nodes generators including Space Station, Mech, and Weapon.
    • Flex's Generators : Free Geometry Nodes presets including Crystal, Curtain, Engine, Lego Character, Pillow, Rope, Stair, Stingwire, Table, Tyre.
    • Nino DefoQ's Generators : Free Geometry Nodes setups for Hair, Braid, Cornrow, Moss, and Snow.
    • Pleebs Generators : Free procedural Geometry Nodes setups including Bush, Wall, and Cobble.
    • Industrial Geonodes : Industrial Geometry Nodes pack featuring Pipes, Vents, and Catwalks.
    • Geometry Nodes Pipes : Generates complex procedural pipe layouts.
    • Stylized Fantasy Tree Generator : Generates stylized fantasy trees with Geometry Nodes.
    • Tiny Eye : Free procedural stylized eye shader and mesh for EEVEE and Cycles.
    • More Geometry Nodes Setups : Droplet Generator, BackdropGen, Random Book Generator, Post USSR Builder, Procedural Slime.

🧊 Modeling

  • MACHIN3tools [$] : Continuously evolving collection of blender tools and pie menus in a single customizable package.
  • QBlocker : Interactive object creation tool for Blender.
  • fspy : Open-source camera matching app, extremely useful for modeling directly from a reference image. (blender addon)
  • PolyQuilt : Provides a few functions in edit mode like creating faces, knife tool, fan, edge-loops, etc. It does this with only the left-mouse-button. So no menu’s, no shortcuts. [more info]
  • Modeling Cloth : Create real-time cloth-like behavior in meshes in Blender.
  • KeKit : Brings some much needed functionality to Blender, with a whole array of production tools.
  • Array Tools : Addon for Blender to create translation, scale, rotation array with offset or global parameters in any direction and mix them.
  • BezierUtility : This add-on contains several tools for working with Bezier curves.
  • Mesh Heal : Add-on for Blender, it includes additional Blender operators for healing surface meshes.
  • JewelCraft : Jewelry design toolkit add-on for Blender.
  • Box Select X-Ray : Modified box select tool that automatically toggles x-ray mode on and off during selection.
  • Polysweeper : Tool to sweep a face profile along a face loop.
  • Edit Split Normals : Edit normals like meshes.
  • Auto Mirror : Automate a series of tasks, such as deleting a half, setting a mirror modifier, setting a clipping, etc.
  • Drop It : Designed to drop fast and simply Objects to Ground or Surface.
  • Maxivz’s Interactive Tools : Collection of intuitive, context sensitive tools for Blender.
  • Synced Modifiers : Allows you to add modifiers to multiple objects at the same time and automatically syncs all the modifiers using Drivers.
  • CAD:
    • Bonsai (formerly BlenderBIM) : An add-on for beautiful, detailed, and data-rich OpenBIM with Blender.
    • Archipack [$] : The Archipack addon for Blender contains a collection of parametric primitives for ArchViz. You can manipulate these primitives with a realtime on-screen editing interface.
    • Building Tools : Building generation addon for blender.
    • Sverchok : Powerful parametric tool for architects, allowing geometry to be programmed visually with nodes.
    • CAD Sketcher : CAD Sketcher is a free and open-source project looking to enhance precision workflows in blender by bringing CAD like tools, features and usability.
    • CAD Transform : CAD Transform provide intuitive snap from/to workflow, allow precise move/rotate/scale using advanced snap options and constraints in both object and edit mode.
    • MeasureIt-ARCH : An expansion of Antonio Vazquez's MeasureIt addon to add features to create Architectural Drawings.
    • JARCH-Vis : Add-on for Blender 3D that helps create commonly used object for architectural visualization.
    • Fusion to Blender Bridge : One-click sync from Fusion 360 to Blender. Geometry updates on each CAD revision while materials, modifiers and hand-marked edges stay.
  • Manufacturing/CAM:
    • BlenderCAM : An Open Source solution for CAM with Blender 3D.
  • 3D Printing:
    • 3D Print Toolbox : Must-have utilities to clean and prepare models for 3D printing in Blender.
    • Snapsplit : Automates cut and connection building workflows for complex 3D models larger than your printing bed, generating precise glue-free snap-fit connectors.
  • Retopology/Remesh:
    • retopoflow : A suite of retopology tools for Blender.
    • QRemeshify : Blender extension for an easy-to-use remesher that outputs high-quality quad topology.
    • AutoRemesher Blender Bridge : Blender bridge add-on for the AutoRemesher auto-retopology tool.
    • InstantMeshesRemesh : A suite of retopology tools for Blender.
    • SpeedRetopo : Free add-on for Blender to make fast and easy retopology using Bsurface.
    • Retopo MT : Tool for retopo, you use it in addition with other addons or tools in Blender, in Edit Mode.
  • Hard Surface:
    • KIT OPS : Can create objects and scenes with extreme efficiency and speed. Complex industrial designs can be generated in a single sitting.
    • ND : Free non-destructive & interactive hard surface toolkit (smart modifiers, booleans, and geometry management)
    • HardOps/Boxcutter [$] : HardOps, is intended to be a workflow assistant toolkit. Boxcutter, the most powerful boolean subsystem for blender.
    • Speedflow [$] : Addon for non-destructive workflow.
    • Bevel After Boolean : Addon comes in handy when working with booleans that have a curved surface.
    • EdgeFlow : This addon adds two operators to blender which both work on edgeloop selections.
    • Engraver : Blender addon with set of few tools designed to help carving decals in 3D models.
    • Offset Edges : This addon introduces a cad-like feature, which create edges that have consistent distance from original selected ones.
    • Mesh Utils : Overlapping vert/edge/face, interior faces, edges by trait, and other stuff.
    • Poly Source : Is designed to simplify the control of the number of different types of polygons. You can see how many Gone, Quad and Tris are on the active object.
  • Sculpt:
    • Blender-Sculpt-Tools : Addon for help sculpting base mesh like Zbrush with Zsphere.
    • Sculpt Alphas Manager : This addon provides a simple solution to be able to quickly switch alpha textures for the sculpt brushes.
    • Speedsculpt [$] : The addon allows you to create very fast characters, to manage Dyntopo Sculpting with booleans, cut curves, skin modifier, decimate, mask etc.
    • GoB : GoZ-alike tools for simple ZBrush-Blender interchange.
    • Brush Manager for Blender : Add-on for Blender that helps you to create custom brushes, store them in a file and organize the library of various categories of brushes.
  • Snapping-Align:
    • Mesh Align Plus : Precisely align, move, and measure+match objects and mesh parts in your 3D scenes.
    • Easy Align : Easy Align addon allows you to align mesh objects origins and align mesh objects to each others easily, it works in both Edit mode and Object mode.
    • Blign : Alignment and distribution tool for Blender. It allows users to align and distribute shapes with many different options.
  • Mesh Generate/Stylization:
    • Tissue : Add-on for computational design.
    • Mech/Fy : Procedural workflow that automates the process of hard surfaces modelling.
    • RandoMesh : A blender addon to add randomized geometry to any mesh.
    • SliceMesh : Simple script for Blender to automate mesh slicing.
    • SuperPoke : Iterative poking tool for Blender.
    • MegaGrid : Simple Python script to randomly spam subdivisions.
    • BY-GEN : Addon designed to simplify the process of creating non-destructive, generative modeling styles in Blender.
    • Fiber Mesh : Generate fiber meshes.
    • Laser Slicer : Cuts up a Blender object and exports the slices to SVG files for cutting on a laser cutter or other post-processing.

🌠 Animation

  • Animation Nodes : A node based visual scripting system designed for motion graphics in Blender.
  • Commotion : Blender add-on for motion graphics.
  • Animax [$] : Procedural animation system for Blender. Useful for animating multiple objects.
  • AutoMask : A Blender Add-on for automatic rotoscoping with the help of Machine Learning.
  • COA Tools : 2D Animation Suite for blender. It offers a 2D cutout animation workflow similar to programs like spine or spriter.
  • reflow : Blender addon to change fps.
  • Shape Keys+ : Adds a panel with extra options for creating, sorting, viewing, and driving shape keys.
  • Stop-Mo : Transforms animations into a beautiful, hand-crafted stop motion style.
  • Blender NLA Midi Copier : Blender add-on for creating midi-driven animations from the Nonlinear Animation view.
  • BlendyPose : Blender Motion Capture using your camera.
  • Rigging:
    • CloudRig : Blender Studio's official feature-film quality Rigify feature set and rig generator for Blender.
    • BlenRig : BlenRig is an Auto-rigging and skinning system. It provides the user with a Feature Film quality rig; including an advanced facial system.
    • Rig on the Fly : Rig on the Fly is a Blender dynamic rigging tool used to simplify and speed up animation workflow.
    • Auto-Rig Pro [$] : Auto-Rig Pro is an addon for Blender to rig characters, retarget animations, and provide Fbx export, with presets for Unity and Unreal Engine.
    • Universal Human Rigged Base Mesh [$] : Rigged human base mesh.
    • Mixamo add-on for Blender by Adobe : This Blender auto control-rig add-on works with characters that have been auto-rigged with the Mixamo service.
    • Rigacar : Generate a complete rig as quickly as possible for standard car models.
    • Wiggle Bones : Jiggle bone implementation for Blender with realistic physics.
    • Spring Bones : Blender addon to add spring/bouncy dynamic effect to bones.
    • Rigid Body Bones : Blender addon which adds rigid body / spring physics to bones.
    • Bone Widget : Blender addon to assist with making custom bone shapes.
  • Writing/Counting:
    • WritingAnimation : This add-on generates writing animation for the selected Bezier curves in blender.
    • Typewriter : Typewriter text animation for font objects.
    • TextCounter : LeoMoon TextCounter is an easy to use text animation plugin for Blender that can be used to make GUI simulations.
    • GreaseWriter : A Blender Add-on for auto-animating grease pencil strokes and emulating hand-drawn text.

🗜 Render Engine

  • AMD Radeon ProRender : Is AMD’s powerful physically-based rendering engine that lets creative professionals use open industry standards to leverage GPU and CPU performance to produce stunningly photorealistic images in Blender.
    • AMD Blender USD Hydra : With Pixar's USD system emerging as a powerful tool for 3D graphics pipelines and interchange, this addon is meant to add first class support for USD and the USD Hydra rendering system to Blender.
  • DreamWork's MoonRay : MoonRay is a physically based path-tracing renderer; it includes a USD Hydra render delegate, multi-machine and cloud rendering via the Arras distributed computation framework.
  • Pixar's RenderMan : Physically-based render from Pixar. [more info]
  • OctaneRender Prime for Blender : Fully integrated Octane Render, free tier. (blender plugin manual)
  • Redshift Blender Integration [$] : Redshift by Maxon is a GPU-accelerated renderer built to meet the specific demands of contemporary high-end production rendering.
  • LuxCore : LuxCoreRender is a physically based and unbiased rendering engine. It offers advanced features like accelerated rendering of indirect light and efficient rendering of caustics. (blender addon)
